name: Four Seasons Resort Costa Rica
positioning: Beach resort on Peninsula Papagayo in Guanacaste, Costa Rica, between two beaches
best_for: Travelers who want a resort between two beaches in Guanacaste
Golfers who want an Arnold Palmer-designed course at the resort
Families who want a dedicated kids' space

facts.text: The resort is in Guanacaste province in northwest Costa Rica.
The resort sits atop a narrow plateau at the tip of Peninsula Papagayo, 97 metres (320 feet) above the Pacific Ocean.
The resort sits between two beaches, Playa Blanca and Playa Virador.
The resort's golf course was designed by Arnold Palmer.
Pesce is an Italian seafood kitchen.
Nemare is a steakhouse at the golf clubhouse.
There are seven restaurants and lounges across the property.

highlights.text: The guest rooms are a tree house concept with hardwood floors.
Virador Beach Club serves Mediterranean and Levantine flavours.
The spa has a two-storey lounge with a rainwater wall.
Bahia is a wood-burning Latin grill.
Kids For All Seasons is a children's space designed by Greek architect Polyanna Paraskeva.

considerations.text: Getting to all parts of the resort and the beach might be difficult for wheelchair users and others who have trouble with uneven terrain.
Restaurant operating hours and opening days are subject to change during the seasons.
WhataHotel notes the remote peninsula location requires planned transportation.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
